properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 22 at 3:52PM PDT until October 22 at 5:30PM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
properties.description:
Continued shower and thunderstorm activity in the area may result in
minor flooding along flood prone roadways around Dyer and Lida.
Report any flooding to local law enforcement.

* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Central Esmeralda County in south central Nevada...

* WHEN...Until 530 PM PDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 352 PM PDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Dyer, Lida and Fish Lake Valley Campground.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

properties.description:

and 3 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.2
to 0.7 inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is
ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Five Points.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Cantua Creek.

deaths occur in vehicles.

enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

travel.

Locations impacted include...
Hatch, Glendale, Alton, Long Valley Junction and Hillsdale.

This includes US Route 89 between mile markers 92 and 123.
properties.instruction:
Monitor the weather situation closely and be alert for threatening
weather conditions.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 22 at 4:41PM MDT until October 22 at 8:15PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Southwestern Saguache, Central Mineral and Western Rio
Grande Counties...

* WHEN...Until 815 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Several
structures are flooded and some sand bagging operations are
continuing. Streams continue to rise due to excess runoff from
continued rainfall.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 439 PM MDT, South Fork Fire and Colorado State Patrol report
continued rainfall across the warned area.
- Water is currently near Highway 160 at Wolf Creek Ranch at mile
marker 177.  Several homes are also being flooded in the South
Fork area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Del Norte, South Fork, Wagon Wheel Gap, Wolf Creek Pass and
Creede.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:

deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 22 at 2:41PM AKDT until October 24 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...South winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 60 mph expected.

* WHERE...St Lawrence Island.

* WHEN...From 10 PM this evening to 4 PM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...High winds may move loose debris, damage property and
cause power outages. Travel could be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A brief period of snow will change to rain by
Friday morning. Wind will increase from the southeast overnight
into Friday morning with peak gusts occurring between 4 AM and 10
AM Friday. In periods of snow, there will likely be low visibility
due to falling and blowing snow.
properties.instruction:
People are urged to secure loose objects that could be blown around
or damaged by the wind.
